markers.name: Stanton
markers.description: A class-G main sequence star.

markers.name: Hurston
markers.description: A wealth of ore and other resources are mined on Hurston to manufacture the company’s line of munitions and weapons. Heavy industry has resulted in severe pollution across the planet.

markers.name: Arial
markers.description: This moon was named after the 3rd CEO of Hurston Dynamics, Arial Hurston, who was known for creating the controversial Life/Labor-style employee contract.

markers.name: Comm Array ST1-13
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Aberdeen
markers.description: This moon was named after scientist Aberdeen Hurston who was credited with designing the company's first antimatter warhead.

markers.name: Comm Array ST1-92
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Ita
markers.description: This moon was named after Ita Hurston, who died during the First Tevarin War, as a reminder of why “the products Hurston Dynamics makes are so important.”

markers.name: Comm Array ST1-02
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Magda
markers.description: This moon was named after Hurston Dynamics CEO Magda Hurston who made the decision to purchase Stanton I from the UEE. Magda is the mother of current CEO “Colonel” Gavin E. Hurston.

markers.name: Comm Array ST1-48
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Comm Array ST1-61
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: ArcCorp
markers.description: Buildings cover a majority of the planet’s surface with residential areas relegated to the poles while ArcCorp’s factories, business headquarters, financial and commercial districts are located in between.

markers.name: Wala
markers.description: The low density of Wala is particularly susceptible to tidal forces which result in the moon being noticeably prolate.

markers.name: Comm Array ST3-35
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Lyria
markers.description: This icy moon features active cryogeysers and cryovolcanoes.

markers.name: Comm Array ST3-18
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Comm Array ST3-90
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: microTech
markers.description: A terraforming error left the planet with an unnaturally dense cloud cover and a colder than average climate making it an ideal location for owner microTech to house its heat-sensitive computing and manufacturing centers.

markers.name: Calliope
markers.description: Named after the ancient Greek muse who inspires eloquence to supposedly remind those gazing upon the moon from microTech to ‘strive for pure expression of thought.’

markers.name: Comm Array ST4-31
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Euterpe
markers.description: Named after the ancient Greek muse of music to supposedly remind those gazing upon the moon from microTech to be guided by ‘the natural rhythm of the universe in their designs.’

markers.name: Comm Array ST4-64
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Clio
markers.description: Named after the ancient Greek muse of history to supposedly remind those gazing upon the moon from microTech to remember that ‘their work stands on those who came before them.’

markers.name: Comm Array ST4-59
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Comm Array ST4-22
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Stanton - Magnus Jump Point
markers.description: This jump point connects Stanton to the Magnus system.

markers.name: Crusader
markers.description: A low mass gas giant that features a breathable atmosphere at high altitudes. This was an ideal situation for ship manufacturer Crusader, who now occupies the planet’s floating platforms to build massive ships like the Starliner.

markers.name: Yela
markers.description: Named after the oldest of the three siblings featured in the 25th century children’s morality tale, 'A Gift for Baba,' this moon has a water-ice crust said to represent Yela’s cool and calculating mannerisms.

markers.name: Comm Array ST2-76
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Daymar
markers.description: Named after the middle brother of the three siblings featured in the 25th century children’s morality tale, 'A Gift for Baba,' this is the largest of Crusader’s moons. Daymar’s slightly eccentric orbit is said to represent his ease at getting lost in the story.

markers.name: Comm Array ST2-47
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.name: Covalex Shipping Hub Gundo
markers.description: Formerly Covalex’s prime shipping hub for the system, Gundo suffered an unfortunate accident and have since moved operations to Orison directly for the time being.

markers.name: Cellin
markers.description: Named after the youngest of the three siblings featured in the 25th century children’s morality tale, 'A Gift for Baba,' this moon features over a hundred currently dormant volcanoes that are said to represent Cellin’s simmering anger.

markers.name: Security Post Kareah
markers.description: A brand new outpost built to house an extended Crusader Security presence in this sector. It is expected to be open and operating soon.

markers.name: Comm Array ST2-28
markers.description: Owned and operated by Aciedo, this communication array provides comm coverage and ECN services to this sector of space.

markers.description: Come to Wikelo Emporium for fine made things. Always looking for useful things. Will trade or make in return. Bye.
